title: The Sun on the Wall
note: b412 — Phase 2, 16-sound stage. Non-fiction note: sun really does warm a rock, which is why small creatures share sunny spots.

pages.brief: A big bright sun rising over a garden wall top at the start of the day.
A flat grey rock on a wall top, sunlight now falling directly on it.
Moss the hedgehog climbing up onto a sunny flat rock.
Fig the caterpillar also settling onto a sunny rock, next to Moss the hedgehog.
Pip the sparrow landing on a rock too, three friends now sharing a warm spot.
Moss the hedgehog, Fig the caterpillar and Pip the sparrow all sitting together on a rock, soaking up sunshine.
Wide view of a warm wall top in full sunshine, a rock and three friends glowing in the light.
